raw: Thirty-four minutes until the Exemplars break through the blockade
content: Thirty-four minutes until the Exemplars break through the blockade

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]Coordinates confirmed, boss. The location in the anonymous warning message is just ahead. And we've identified the source—
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Coordinates confirmed, boss. The location in the anonymous warning message is just ahead. And we've identified the source—

speaker: Millscar
content: Rhodes Island.

speaker: Millscar
content: No surprises there. Let's go.

raw: The mercenary does not move. There is uncertainty on his face.
content: The mercenary does not move. There is uncertainty on his face.

speaker: Millscar
content: Out with it.

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]The boys trust you. Without you, we would have rotted in the alleys, or the devils would have—
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: The boys trust you. Without you, we would have rotted in the alleys, or the devils would have—

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]I've already died once, so I'm fine with putting my head on the line for you. But this just doesn't make sense. Why should we trust Rhodes Island? We know nothing about them.
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: I've already died once, so I'm fine with putting my head on the line for you. But this just doesn't make sense. Why should we trust Rhodes Island? We know nothing about them.

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]The Exemplars are almost inside the city. It's going to be bedlam outside. We could take this opportunity to line our pockets...
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: The Exemplars are almost inside the city. It's going to be bedlam outside. We could take this opportunity to line our pockets...

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]Or at least... you should not risk yourself, being here.
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Or at least... you should not risk yourself, being here.

raw: [name="Millscar"]You're not the only one who thinks this way, are you?
speaker: Millscar
content: You're not the only one who thinks this way, are you?

raw: The mercenary is silent. He dares not meet Millscar's gaze, fearing her wrath.
content: The mercenary is silent. He dares not meet Millscar's gaze, fearing her wrath.
But nothing happens.

raw: [name="Millscar"]Have you thought about what will become of Londinium after this war?
speaker: Millscar
content: Have you thought about what will become of Londinium after this war?

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]Er... the way it used to be?
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Er... the way it used to be?

raw: [name="Millscar"]No, nothing will go back to the way it used to be. No one can go back, no matter what comes of this war.
speaker: Millscar
content: No, nothing will go back to the way it used to be. No one can go back, no matter what comes of this war.

speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Y-You're abandoning us?

raw: [name="Millscar"]No, I need you. Soon, Londinium will become a city in need of mending.
speaker: Millscar
content: No, I need you. Soon, Londinium will become a city in need of mending.

raw: [name="Millscar"]The old order has been destroyed by death and violence. There will be plenty of gaps left behind, plenty to feed us.
speaker: Millscar
content: The old order has been destroyed by death and violence. There will be plenty of gaps left behind, plenty to feed us.

speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: But—

speaker: Millscar
content: I'm not asking your opinion.

raw: [name="Millscar"]Listen, I don't plan on going back to the old life, which means we have to plan for a new one. I haven't forgotten about you, of course.
speaker: Millscar
content: Listen, I don't plan on going back to the old life, which means we have to plan for a new one. I haven't forgotten about you, of course.

raw: [name="Millscar"]In order to keep our livelihood, we need people to know what we're capable of.
speaker: Millscar
content: In order to keep our livelihood, we need people to know what we're capable of.

raw: [name="Millscar"]Don't say I didn't give you a choice. So, are you coming or not?
speaker: Millscar
content: Don't say I didn't give you a choice. So, are you coming or not?

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]Oh, sod it, put me at the front of the line, boss.
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Oh, sod it, put me at the front of the line, boss.

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]I'm not imagining it, am I... what is this...?
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: I'm not imagining it, am I... what is this...?

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]The blood-red rocks in the gaps of the frame and in the furnace... did the devils hide them here? What are they planning?
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: The blood-red rocks in the gaps of the frame and in the furnace... did the devils hide them here? What are they planning?

speaker: Millscar
content: Vampire stuff.

raw: There is a faint smell of blood in the air. She recalls the onrushing squirming monsters that came straight out of a nightmare.
content: There is a faint smell of blood in the air. She recalls the onrushing squirming monsters that came straight out of a nightmare.

speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Boss! I found something here!

speaker: Millscar
content: A ducal alliance soldier?

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]Something's not right. He hasn't been dead for long. The name tag... Fifth Infantry Regiment, Eighth Column. Rank... Major?!
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Something's not right. He hasn't been dead for long. The name tag... Fifth Infantry Regiment, Eighth Column. Rank... Major?!

raw: [name="Millscar"]The Earl of March's troops, under the Duke of Normandy. No external wounds, but the death was not natural.
speaker: Millscar
content: The Earl of March's troops, under the Duke of Normandy. No external wounds, but the death was not natural.

raw: [name="Millscar"]Her unit should still be outside the walls. Why would a major from the unit be here—
speaker: Millscar
content: Her unit should still be outside the walls. Why would a major from the unit be here—

raw: [name="???"]Where did they come from? Kill them, and quickly. The orders must not be delayed.
content: Where did they come from? Kill them, and quickly. The orders must not be delayed.

raw: [name="???"]There are other altars that still need to be activated. There is no time.
content: There are other altars that still need to be activated. There is no time.

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]The devils have us surrounded! There's no way out—
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: The devils have us surrounded! There's no way out—

speaker: Millscar
content: Why do we need one?
'Lunatic'.

raw: No one knows where the Steam Knight sword in her hand came from, much less where Millscar herself came from.
content: No one knows where the Steam Knight sword in her hand came from, much less where Millscar herself came from.

raw: The mercenary's legs tremble. He regrets not turning around a few minutes ago.
content: The mercenary's legs tremble. He regrets not turning around a few minutes ago.

raw: As long as that purple blade would not impale him from behind.
content: As long as that purple blade would not impale him from behind.

speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Bugger all.

speaker: Nadine
content: Huh. I know that sword.

raw: [name="Nadine"]The General's briefing mentioned you. You've got nerve. Is the tin can somewhere nearby?
speaker: Nadine
content: The General's briefing mentioned you. You've got nerve. Is the tin can somewhere nearby?

raw: [name="Nadine"]Maybe we can kill two fowlbeasts with one stone.
speaker: Nadine
content: Maybe we can kill two fowlbeasts with one stone.

speaker: Millscar
content: Hmph.

[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Nadine"]Carry on with your work, I'll handle this—
speaker: Nadine
content: Carry on with your work, I'll handle this—
*jingle*

raw: Like wind chimes on the beams of a mausoleuma caressed by a breeze, the golden pendants and gems that hang from the veil of the one who slumbers sway and clang against each other in the air.
content: Like wind chimes on the beams of a mausoleuma caressed by a breeze, the golden pendants and gems that hang from the veil of the one who slumbers sway and clang against each other in the air.

raw: [name="???"]Excuse me, did anyone see my earring?
content: Excuse me, did anyone see my earring?

raw: [name="???"]There you are, Little Garnet—Oh, it's broken...
content: There you are, Little Garnet—Oh, it's broken...

raw: [name="???"]I guess I'll have to borrow your toys, Duq'arael. Not like you're in any position to refuse.
content: I guess I'll have to borrow your toys, Duq'arael. Not like you're in any position to refuse.

The blood-red altar within the iron frame begins to glow, but quickly goes dark again and then shatters.
content: The blood-red altar within the iron frame begins to glow, but quickly goes dark again and then shatters.

raw: The broken red pendant in the air is now good as new, glowing with a faint light.
content: The broken red pendant in the air is now good as new, glowing with a faint light.

raw: The red glow is almost mesmerizing.
content: The red glow is almost mesmerizing.
*jingle*

raw: The sound echoes by Millscar's ear.
content: The sound echoes by Millscar's ear.

raw: [name="???"]Take care of Little Garnet for me, for a while.
content: Take care of Little Garnet for me, for a while.

raw: [name="???"]She'll lead you where you belong. Now, you should go.
content: She'll lead you where you belong. Now, you should go.

raw: [name="???"]I'm surprised that anyone like Dame Kal'tsit would trust you, though.
content: I'm surprised that anyone like Dame Kal'tsit would trust you, though.

raw: [ImageTween(xFrom=120, yFrom=-50, xTo=0, yTo=0, xScaleFrom=1.2, yScaleFrom=1.2, xScaleTo=1, yScaleTo=1, duration=12, block=false)]
She sees the red and black figure.
content: She sees the red and black figure.

raw: Why would a vampire save my life? Dame Kal'tsit? Dr. Kal'tsit of Rhodes Island? What are they planning?
content: Why would a vampire save my life? Dame Kal'tsit? Dr. Kal'tsit of Rhodes Island? What are they planning?

raw: She has many questions, but finds herself holding the cold conical earring in her hand.
content: She has many questions, but finds herself holding the cold conical earring in her hand.

raw: [name="Mysterious Vampire"]There's no time to waste if you want to help that one. This is not the only altar in these parts.
speaker: Mysterious Vampire
content: There's no time to waste if you want to help that one. This is not the only altar in these parts.

speaker: Millscar
content: What do I do?

speaker: Mysterious Vampire
content: She will tell you.

raw: 'She'? Millscar suddenly feels a pulse from the earring in her hand, like a heartbeat.
content: 'She'? Millscar suddenly feels a pulse from the earring in her hand, like a heartbeat.

speaker: Nadine
content: Stop her—

speaker: Mysterious Vampire
content: Shh.

speaker: Nadine
content: *Sarkaz expletive*!

raw: Nadine feels all the blood in her body rush back towards her heart for a second, and the vertigo that comes with it.
content: Nadine feels all the blood in her body rush back towards her heart for a second, and the vertigo that comes with it.

raw: For the first time, she envies the kindred who have abandoned flesh and blood.
content: For the first time, she envies the kindred who have abandoned flesh and blood.

speaker: Mysterious Vampire
content: The path has been prepared.

raw: [name="Mysterious Vampire"]Take care of her, and she will guide you to me.
speaker: Mysterious Vampire
content: Take care of her, and she will guide you to me.

content: Six minutes until the Exemplars break through the blockade

speaker: Millscar
content: Let's go to the next one.

raw: [name="Concerned Mercenary"]Boss, that weird Vampire thing... as we destroy the altars, it just keeps getting... prettier.
speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Boss, that weird Vampire thing... as we destroy the altars, it just keeps getting... prettier.

raw: [name="Millscar"]We've got more important things to worry about. Word is that the Exemplars have made it into the city, but they're being impeded by the ducal alliance's troops.
speaker: Millscar
content: We've got more important things to worry about. Word is that the Exemplars have made it into the city, but they're being impeded by the ducal alliance's troops.

speaker: Millscar
content: Have the factories gotten the order?

speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Aye. They're getting ready.

raw: [name="Millscar"]These strange hidden Sarkaz altars, and rumors that the dukes are ready to leave Londinium blockaded and abandon it to its fate...
speaker: Millscar
content: These strange hidden Sarkaz altars, and rumors that the dukes are ready to leave Londinium blockaded and abandon it to its fate...

raw: [name="Millscar"]Hah. Who's the one who actually wants to blow up the city?
speaker: Millscar
content: Hah. Who's the one who actually wants to blow up the city?
Does it really matter?

speaker: Clovisia
content: It's been a while, Allerdale.

speaker: Millscar
content: I thought you were dead.

speaker: Clovisia
content: I thought YOU were dead.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]Even with Rhodes Island's help, there are too many of these for you to deal with, and too little time.
speaker: Clovisia
content: Even with Rhodes Island's help, there are too many of these for you to deal with, and too little time.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]Who knows how many such altars the Sarkaz have hidden across the city? Without my knowledge, too. They could not have done it on their own.
speaker: Clovisia
content: Who knows how many such altars the Sarkaz have hidden across the city? Without my knowledge, too. They could not have done it on their own.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]More than one key district will be reduced to rubble if these altars are activated. I've discovered and destroyed several key ones, however.
speaker: Clovisia
content: More than one key district will be reduced to rubble if these altars are activated. I've discovered and destroyed several key ones, however.

speaker: Millscar
content: By yourself...?

raw: [name="Clovisia"]Vina needs help. The Exemplars need one final push. And the dukes need to hear the true voice of the people.
speaker: Clovisia
content: Vina needs help. The Exemplars need one final push. And the dukes need to hear the true voice of the people.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]It was I who spread the rumors that the dukes are planning to abandon Londinium. Not that there wasn't an element of truth to it.
speaker: Clovisia
content: It was I who spread the rumors that the dukes are planning to abandon Londinium. Not that there wasn't an element of truth to it.

raw: [name="Millscar"]What do you want me to do?
speaker: Millscar
content: What do you want me to do?

raw: [name="Clovisia"]You're already doing it. You and those who follow you.
speaker: Clovisia
content: You're already doing it. You and those who follow you.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]But you, too, need a little push. I'll take care of the remaining altars.
speaker: Clovisia
content: But you, too, need a little push. I'll take care of the remaining altars.

speaker: Millscar
content: You've changed. A lot.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]I could say the same for you, 'Millscar'. Are you sure you like that name?
speaker: Clovisia
content: I could say the same for you, 'Millscar'. Are you sure you like that name?

raw: [name="Clovisia"]You've chosen to live. Then follow the path, and see where it leads.
speaker: Clovisia
content: You've chosen to live. Then follow the path, and see where it leads.

speaker: Concerned Mercenary
content: Boss, she's—

raw: [name="Millscar"]Run like you've got all Kazdel on your heels. Go to the outer city, and tell the others to get ready to receive the Exemplars.
speaker: Millscar
content: Run like you've got all Kazdel on your heels. Go to the outer city, and tell the others to get ready to receive the Exemplars.

content: Two days after the Exemplars break through the blockade

raw: [name="Morgan"]I never knew taking inventory could be such a pain.
speaker: Morgan
content: I never knew taking inventory could be such a pain.

raw: [name="Morgan"]Taking inventory at the factories on our turf back in the day wasn't half as bad...
speaker: Morgan
content: Taking inventory at the factories on our turf back in the day wasn't half as bad...

raw: [name="Vina"]If this is pain, I'll gladly take more pain.
speaker: Vina
content: If this is pain, I'll gladly take more pain.

raw: [name="Morgan"]It sure is exciting, though, to see so many people supporting us—
speaker: Morgan
content: It sure is exciting, though, to see so many people supporting us—

raw: [name="Morgan"](Yawn) We've been at this all night. The sun's already coming up.
speaker: Morgan
content: (Yawn) We've been at this all night. The sun's already coming up.

raw: [name="Vina"]We have to push forward. The others can only buy so much time.
speaker: Vina
content: We have to push forward. The others can only buy so much time.

raw: [name="Vina"]Word from Wiš'adel is that they threw a dozen wrenches into the Military Commission's system of command, but the Nachzehrers are still guarding Westhaleg.
speaker: Vina
content: Word from Wiš'adel is that they threw a dozen wrenches into the Military Commission's system of command, but the Nachzehrers are still guarding Westhaleg.

raw: [name="Vina"]We've been inside the city for two days, but there has been little sign of movement from them.
speaker: Vina
content: We've been inside the city for two days, but there has been little sign of movement from them.

speaker: Morgan
content: Weren't there rumors that Theresis has abandoned them and gone into hiding? Maybe that's why the Nachzehrers aren't moving.

raw: [name="Vina"]That's just speculation. Not even the Doctor's team has been able to confirm it.

content: That's just speculation. Not even the Doctor's team has been able to confirm it.

raw: [name="Vina"]Get some rest, Morgan. The alliance's order to attack will come soon—

content: I want to help Dagda. I reckon I've got a little more experience sweet-talking people into helping us.

content: Delphine is persuading the nobles who are still on the fence. Hannah and Catherine are organizing the surviving workers and Self-Salvation Corps. I have no doubt they can get it done.

raw: [name="Morgan"]But Dagda... she's not really the temperament for this...
speaker: Morgan
content: But Dagda... she's not really the temperament for this...

speaker: Vina
content: Go help her.

speaker: Vina
content: Phew.

raw: [name="Vina"]Let's continue. Supplies from Heidi... improvised weapons by the Self-Salvation Corps...

content: Let's continue. Supplies from Heidi... improvised weapons by the Self-Salvation Corps...

speaker: Vina
content: Huh?

raw: [name="Vina"]What's this at the bottom? It's not on the list.

content: What's this at the bottom? It's not on the list.

content: Let's go. It's time.

content: What's the situation, boss?

raw: [name="Millscar"]Their equipment is inferior to the alliance's. The dukes are having the Exemplars take the brunt of the fighting. Casualties will be heavy...

content: Their equipment is inferior to the alliance's. The dukes are having the Exemplars take the brunt of the fighting. Casualties will be heavy...

content: But this is also an opportunity.

raw: [name="Millscar"]The dukes want a hero. The people need a hero. Why not add a finishing touch to the story?
speaker: Millscar
content: The dukes want a hero. The people need a hero. Why not add a finishing touch to the story?

raw: [name="Alert Mercenary"]You're betting on them to win.

content: You're betting on them to win.

content: Bet? No, the bets were already made when the battle outside the walls ended. This is just the last chance to double down.

content: No idea how that works, but whatever you say. What's next?

speaker: Millscar
content: We kill.

content: There will be chaos once the final battle begins, and 'opportunists' too. I'm not about to let them do whatever they want right under my nose.

raw: [name="Alert Mercenary"]Say... boss, what was that thing you left behind?
